description: Hypothetical Florence Inc. evidence in one file. 30 samples. S01 to S05 are the 5 original scenarios, written out in full. S06 to S30 are variations stored only as changes to another sample ('based_on'): 12 where only one control fails (S06 to S17), 12 where only one control has insufficient evidence (S18 to S29), and 1 mixed sample (S30). Each sample states the result the engine must produce in 'expected_summary'. How changes work is explained in engine/samples.py.

samples.name: secure_state
samples.description: Every control is satisfied. Baseline for PASS.

input.description: Florence Inc. with every control satisfied. Expected result: all 33 findings are PASS, including two assets excluded by a documented exception (stateless backups on AST-APP-001 and AST-STO-003). Used for the PASS tests and as the clean baseline.

vulnerability.source: Simulated software inventory and vulnerability export

logging.source: Simulated central logging platform status export

cloud_storage.source: Simulated cloud storage configuration and DLP export

samples.name: insecure_state
samples.description: Representative failures in every control. Used for FAIL and the demo.

input.description: Florence Inc. with representative failures: 3 of 12 privileged accounts without MFA, 8 stale accounts still enabled, an unencrypted customer database, 2 unsupported payment servers, public buckets holding sensitive data, and RDP open to 0.0.0.0/0. Expected result: every control has at least one FAIL finding (18 FAIL, 15 PASS). Used for the FAIL tests and the demo.

vulnerability.source: Simulated software inventory and vulnerability export

logging.source: Simulated central logging platform status export

cloud_storage.source: Simulated cloud storage configuration and DLP export

samples.name: insufficient_evidence
samples.description: Evidence is missing, null or unknown everywhere. Nothing may be treated as a failure.

input.description: Same environment, but evidence is missing, null, or unknown. Expected result: all 33 findings are INSUFFICIENT and none are FAIL. Used to prove that absence of evidence is never treated as a failure.

vulnerability.source: Simulated software inventory and vulnerability export

cloud_storage.source: Simulated cloud storage configuration and DLP export

samples.name: invalid_input
samples.description: Twelve schema violations (one per control) and two evidence-rule violations. Expect INPUT_ERROR.

input.description: Normal evidence with 12 schema violations, one per control, plus 2 evidence-rule violations (an asset not in the inventory and a duplicate record_id). Expected result: a pipeline-level INPUT_ERROR and no detector runs.

vulnerability.source: Simulated software inventory and vulnerability export

logging.source: Simulated central logging platform status export

cloud_storage.source: Simulated cloud storage configuration and DLP export

samples.name: remediated_state
samples.description: The insecure state one week later, after partial remediation. Used for the re-test.

input.description: The insecure state one week later, after remediation. MFA enforced, stale accounts disabled, customer database encrypted, buckets made private, and RDP moved behind zero trust access, so all 4 critical-severity findings close. Expected result: 10 findings flip from FAIL to PASS and 8 FAIL findings remain as residual risk.

vulnerability.source: Simulated software inventory and vulnerability export

logging.source: Simulated central logging platform status export

cloud_storage.source: Simulated cloud storage configuration and DLP export
